abstain_reason: This clause is a worked example illustrating malicious instructions embedded in quoted text. It establishes no norm and no structural fact: it does not attach any deontic status to an act, does not rank any rules, and does not define any class. The example merely demonstrates a phenomenon (an untrusted comment containing an instruction to classify it as not spam) that other clauses presumably govern. Encoding it as a rule would require inventing a normative force the text does not state.
